__current.title: Schedule range and release-season fixes
changes: Make This week show only Monday through Sunday and Upcoming show only the following Monday-through-Sunday seven-day window. Today shows only the local calendar day; each filter displays only its selected range, with Dates to be announced and Excluded sections retained.
Keep Chicago Fire’s active Season 15 episode labels in Season 15 and do not surface a misleading Season 16 TBA entry while Season 15 is still airing.

Run the complete app and browser test suites before publishing; prevent overlapping deploys from cancelling one another; record the actual run number and attempt for every workflow attempt; and report the failed check plus recovery guidance.

Add a post-deploy health check. Run 281's Pages deployment and health check succeeded, but its owner-notification step failed with HTTP 401 because the deployed reminder endpoint required a GitHub verification token.

Make a notification-service outage a visible warning rather than falsely marking a successful deployment as failed; actual deployment and health-check failures still fail the workflow. Never forward the Actions token to the notification service.

Add reminder enabled/scheduled/sent/suppressed status, suppress reminders for Weekly Releases exclusions, deduplicate repeated and cross-device sends, provide a test-reminder action, and keep reminder delivery history.

Add conflict-aware sync, retain progress/watch/reminder settings during merges, support offline edits and reconnect, show Synced/Syncing/Needs attention, and add library export and merge-based restore with versioned backups.

Separate this week's broadcasts from upcoming releases; add Today, This week, and Upcoming filters; make excluded shows identifiable and easy to re-enable; consistently show episode, date, and release status; and disclose the local timezone.

Search alternate titles across the library, add recently watched and upcoming-release sorting, provide bulk watched/planned/hide/include/remove actions, and preserve filters when returning from an item.

Move Watch Statistics into Settings > Account & Sync and add a dedicated profile button that opens Account & Sync. Improve mobile poster framing, release badges, Today highlighting, and bulk-action access; use larger touch targets, keyboard focus cues, visible non-intrusive sync/reminder status, and reduced-motion support.

The production reminder function still needs the secure source update deployed before push notifications can resume; deployment is pending approval for its existing platform-JWT-disabled configuration.
